item.title: World leaders warn against security flaw found in PHP computer programming
item.description: AI was used to pinpoint two vulnerabilities in the PHP language, used by more than 70 percent of websites.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC vows invasion as defence doctrine turns ‘offensive’
item.description: Iran's IRGC threatens to invade any country that attacks it under a new 'offensive and asymmetrical' doctrine.

item.title: US accuses Canada of election interference ahead of midterms
item.description: Washington cites Canadian tariffs, political meetings and anti-Trump ads as evidence of attempted election interference.

item.title: What happened during Witkoff and Kushner’s latest meeting with Putin
item.description: The latest round of negotiations comes amid growing concerns in Kyiv the US is backing away from its support of Ukraine.

item.title: Pope Leo needs no further treatment after cancer surgery, doctors say
item.description: The 71-year-old leader of the Catholic Church has had the lower lobe of his right lung removed in surgery.

item.title: Nigeria’s first Ebola case matches DR Congo strain, health officials say
item.description: The Bundibugyo strain outbreak is the DR Congo's deadliest ever and has now reached West Africa for the first time.

item.title: US orders departure of personnel from Saudi Arabia, citing Houthi threat
item.description: US State Department says Iran-aligned Houthis have 'increasingly ⁠⁠engaged in hostilities' against Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Canadian publisher drops writer Thelyson Orelien over AI use in novel
item.description: Publisher Boreal says investigations confirmed the Haitian-Canadian Thelyson Orelien used AI in his breakthrough novel.

item.title: Video shows Israeli settler assaulting Palestinian child
item.description: An Israeli settler was filmed shouting at and assaulting a Palestinian child during an attack on a family east of Yatta.

item.title: Man United captain Fernandes slams Carrick’s tactics after Como hammering
item.description: Manchester United winless run continues with 4-1 Champions League humbling in Como, and Bruno Fernandes slams tactics.

item.title: Tehran displays mock installation of Trump behind bars
item.description: An Iranian performer in Tehran’s busy Tajrish Square has impersonated US President Donald Trump behind bars.

item.title: Real Madrid rout RB Leipzig 4-1 to continue perfect Champions League start
item.description: Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande score stunners as Real beat Leipzig to make it three from three in the Champions League.

item.title: Declan Rice grabs Arsenal draw at Bayern Munich in Champions League
item.description: Eze gave Arsenal the lead, but Davies levelled and Kane netted a penalty for the hosts before Rice made it 2-2.

item.title: Mexico charges prosecutor with treason over US involvement in drug raid
item.description: The participation of US agents in an April drug operation has raised questions about whether Mexico's laws were upheld.

item.title: Trump heads to South Carolina to boost Senator Darline Graham in race
item.description: The race between the sister of late Senator Lindsey Graham and Democrat Annie Andrews has tightened in deep-red state.

item.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25bn in fines for Facebook privacy violations
item.description: A jury found Meta guilty of lying to Facebook users in ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠New Mexico about access to their data.

item.title: Will Russia’s diesel shipment to the US lower prices before midterms?
item.description: Moscow dispatches its inaugural diesel shipment to the US, aiming to ease fuel shortages as midterm elections loom.

item.title: Colombia seizes 7.6 tonnes of cocaine in biggest haul in a decade
item.description: Colombian authorities have seized 7.6 tonnes of cocaine at the Caribbean port of Cartagena

item.title: Jason Alexander recalls Palestinian protection in Ramallah
item.description: Seinfeld actor Jason Alexander recalls a visit to Ramallah that challenged his fears about visiting Palestinian cities.

item.title: Cuba accuses US of threatening countries ahead of UN embargo vote
item.description: Havana says Washington is threatening countries with retaliation if they refuse to vote against condemning its embargo.

item.title: What happened to Australian politician Helen Haines?
item.description: Australian Lawmaker Helen Haines has lost both legs after a car rammed into her.

item.title: UK Conservative Party suspends ex-candidate after Al Jazeera investigation
item.description: The UK's Conservatives suspend former candidate Jack Ross after he was filmed discussing hiring contract killers.

item.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ leaders free after a week in jail
item.description: Two top leaders of India’s Cockroach Party, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das, have been released after a week in jail.

item.title: Tunisia jails opposition politician for four years over social media posts
item.description: Olfa ⁠Hamdi, a US-Tunisian national, was convicted of 'plotting' and 'inciting' military to disobey orders.

item.title: Russia willing to resume peace talks with Ukraine, US after Witkoff visit
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has signalled Moscow is willing in principle to resume talks with Ukraine and the US.
